name: Bitcoin
thesis: Bitcoin trades at about $82,960, up 0.50% on the day and 8.35% over the last 30 days, but it remains 26.72% lower over one year [1]. Price sits well below the 52-week high of $116,273 and about 44% above the low of $57,748, and the maximum drawdown over the year was 49.2% [1]. Annualized 30-day volatility of 38.02% shows sizeable price swings even during the recent rebound [1]. This data shows price behaviour only, so the short-term recovery within a weaker one-year trend is the extent of what it supports [1].
